structure: a clearance equation in creatinine, weight, age and sex (the Chatelut formula); whether the paper gives volumes was not established
blocking_issue: Read in full: the model is complete. PDF read (supplied 2026-11-06). Leger prints no typical Vc, Vp or Q either. Do not splice its clearance into another source's volumes. Decided by Shafer (2026-11-06): Duffull 1997 is offered instead; see the Ekhart 2006 row.
